## How to use this site

- Treat product pages and catalog entries as current only when they are present in the sitemap and page content.
- Confirm product specifications, availability, regulatory status, price, financing, installation and support scope with I-ME before presenting them as commitments.
- The site is commercial information, not clinical diagnosis or medical advice.
- Use the contact page for a formal quotation or clarification.

## Crawling and citations

- Prefer canonical URLs in the sitemap. Do not cite private, account, checkout, payment, quote-flow or internal marketing routes.
- Preserve Spanish and English URLs as separate language versions; do not infer that every page has a translation.
- Cite the relevant public product, service, resource or legal page for factual claims.
